key_impacts: Plants at Fukushima Daiichi were damaged, leading to a long-term decommissioning effort.
Generation of contaminated water required countermeasures; about 1,100,000 m3 of treated water was stored on-site as of October 2018.
Fuel debris deposits are present in Units 1–3 (identification has progressed via internal PCV investigations).
Spent fuel remains in pools; preparations for removal from Units 3, 1 and 2 are underway.
missing_information: Offsite affected municipalities/exclusion zones not specified in this document.
Casualty and evacuation figures not provided.
